card.name: Comma after Addiction in opioid warnings
card.fires_on: The comma right after the word Addiction (or addiction) in the opioid phrase "Addiction, Abuse, and Misuse". It appears in boxed warnings, section headings and REMS text.

modes.label: Heading
modes.description: Comma after Addiction in the capitalized warning heading.

modes.label: Running text
modes.description: Comma after lowercase addiction in the REMS sentence about risks.
modes.example: outweigh the risks of addiction<<,>> abuse, and misuse, the Food and

card.writes: It lowers the odds of the word drug or drugs coming next, with little else clear.
card.plain: It marks the comma in the stock opioid phrase "addiction, abuse, and misuse".
